description: This file manages platform assignment to test plans within the TestLink project. It includes initializing page components, handling user actions for linking/unlinking platforms, and generating dynamic UI elements for platform management.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine instance used for rendering the webpage.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Manager class for handling test plan related database operations.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Manager class for platform-related database operations.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP class for creating dynamic objects.

methods.name: init_option_panels
methods.description: Initializes option transfer panels and builds a JavaScript map of platforms to their linked test case counts.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Parses request parameters and initializes the arguments object for platform assignment actions.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies that the current user has permission to add or remove platforms from test plans.
